scope: Generated synthetic cohort; observed-data-only alert policy; patient-level episode evaluation

definitions.episode_match: At least one alert between labelled onset and escalation-window start, inclusive.
definitions.precision: Alert episodes (alerts for one patient within a 30-minute interval are clustered) that overlap a labelled onset-to-escalation interval divided by all alert episodes.
definitions.recall: Episodes with an alert in the matching window divided by all labelled positive episodes.
definitions.duplicate_suppression: Confirmed trigger candidates suppressed by cooldown divided by candidates either suppressed or raised.
definitions.artifact_false_positive: Artifact-labelled observations receiving an alert divided by all artifact-labelled observations.
